mapper.select: SELECT id, name, role, tagline, email, location, avatar, resume_url AS resumeUrl, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM site_profile WHERE id = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site_profile WHERE id = 1
SELECT content FROM site_intro ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT label, value FROM site_fact ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT label, href, icon FROM site_social ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT label, anchor AS id, path AS `to` FROM site_nav ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT period, title, org, descr AS `desc` FROM timeline_item ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT id, title AS `group`, descr AS `desc` FROM skill_group ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT group_id AS groupId, name, icon, level FROM skill_item ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT id, slug, title, summary, project_year AS `year`, role, cover, glyph, background, outcome FROM project ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT project_id AS projectId, tag FROM project_tag ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT project_id AS projectId, label, href FROM project_link ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT project_id AS projectId, content FROM project_step ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT project_id AS projectId, title, detail FROM project_challenge ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT id, slug, title, publish_date AS `date`, summary, body FROM post ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT post_id AS postId, tag FROM post_tag ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT v FROM site_meta WHERE k = #{k}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_profile (id, name, role, tagline, email, location, avatar, resume_url, updated_at) VALUES (1, #{name}, #{role}, #{tagline}, #{email}, #{location}, #{avatar}, #{resumeUrl}, NOW()) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = new.name, role = new.role, tagline = new.tagline, email = new.email, location = new.location, avatar = new.avatar, resume_url = new.resume_url, updated_at = NOW()
INSERT INTO site_meta (k, v) VALUES (#{k}, #{v}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE v = new.v
INSERT INTO site_fact (sort_no, label, value) VALUES (#{sortNo}, #{label}, #{value})
INSERT INTO site_social (sort_no, label, href, icon) VALUES (#{sortNo}, #{label}, #{href}, #{icon})
INSERT INTO site_nav (sort_no, label, anchor, path) VALUES (#{sortNo}, #{label}, #{anchor}, #{path})
INSERT INTO timeline_item (sort_no, period, title, org, descr) VALUES (#{sortNo}, #{period}, #{title}, #{org}, #{descr})
INSERT INTO skill_group (sort_no, title, descr) VALUES (#{sortNo}, #{title}, #{descr})
INSERT INTO skill_item (group_id, sort_no, name, icon, level) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{sortNo}, #{name}, #{icon}, #{level})

INSERT INTO project (sort_no, slug, title, summary, project_year, role, cover, glyph, background, outcome) VALUES (#{sortNo}, #{slug}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{projectYear}, #{role}, #{cover}, #{glyph}, #{background}, #{outcome})
INSERT INTO project_tag (project_id, sort_no, tag) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{sortNo}, #{tag})
INSERT INTO project_link (project_id, sort_no, label, href) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{sortNo}, #{label}, #{href})
INSERT INTO project_step (project_id, sort_no, content) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{sortNo}, #{content})
INSERT INTO project_challenge (project_id, sort_no, title, detail) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{sortNo}, #{title}, #{detail})
INSERT INTO post (sort_no, slug, title, publish_date, summary, body) VALUES (#{sortNo}, #{slug}, #{title}, #{publishDate}, #{summary}, #{body})
INSERT INTO post_tag (post_id, sort_no, tag) VALUES (#{postId}, #{sortNo}, #{tag})
